about: Bathurst is a city on Chaleur Bay in northeastern New Brunswick, at the mouth of the Nepisiguit River. Acadian and English bilingual culture, mining and pulp heritage, and a role as a service hub for the Acadian Peninsula and Bay of Chaleur define the community. About 12,000 people live in Bathurst.
